_readme: SAARTHI — Ask section ka test-set. eval-ask.mjs ise padhti hai.
DO SET, DO ALAG RAASTE:
hindi_100    — Devanagari mein likhe sawaal (default). Ye asli app ka
mukhya raasta hai aur granth-paryay ka imtihaan bhi.
hinglish_100 — Roman mein likhe sawaal. Ye TRANSLIT ka raasta jaanchta
hai. --hinglish se chalao.
'any' = wo shabd jinme se KOI EK sahi ansh mein hona chahiye. Har shabd
corpus mein pehle GINA gaya hai (5.66 crore akshar) — yaani sawaal fail
hone ka matlab DHOONDHNE ki galti hai, kitab mein kami nahi. Jahan shabd
kam mila wahan vyapak shabd liya:
आत्मविश्वास 6 hits → धैर्य/बल/साहस     चिंता 75  → चिन्ता 1,267
संतुलन 20          → समता/सम           मंदिर 83  → मन्दिर 561
सकारात्मक 4        → शुभ/विचार         तनाव 38   → उद्वेग/क्लेश
'compare': true = 'X aur Y mein kya antar hai' kism ka sawaal. Ye MAIN
SCORE MEIN GINE JAATE HAIN — chhipaye nahi. Bas alag se bhi dikhaye jaate
hain, kyunki pichhli baar aise 4 me se 4 fail hue the aur ye jaanna zaroori
hai ki wo alag kism ki kami hai (ek ansh do cheezon ka antar kam hi batata
hai) ya wahi aam kami.
'control' = jiska jawab kitaabon mein hai hi nahi. Sahi natija = kuch bhi
grounded na mile. Yahan ek bhi citation JHOOTHI citation hai.
